test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following sportspersons has been a nominated Rajya Sabha member since 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PT Usha**__

**__Key Points__**
__

• **PT Usha**, the legendary Indian track and field athlete, was nominated to the **Rajya Sabha** (the Upper House of Parliament) in **July 2022**.

• She was nominated by the **President of India** under the category of distinguished persons from various fields, alongside other personalities like music composer **Ilaiyaraaja**, philanthropist **Veerendra Heggade**, and screenwriter **V. Vijayendra Prasad**.

• **Mary Kom**, the renowned boxer, was nominated to the Rajya Sabha in **2016** and her term concluded in **2022**.

• **Sachin Tendulkar** was the first active sportsperson to be nominated to the Rajya Sabha, serving his term from **2012 to 2018**.

• **Abhinav Bindra**, India's first individual Olympic gold medalist, has **not** been a nominated member of the Rajya Sabha.

**Additional Information__**

• **PT Usha** is popularly known as the **Payyoli Express** and is considered one of the greatest athletes India has ever produced.

• In December 2022, she made history by becoming the first woman **President** of the **Indian Olympic Association (IOA)**.

• According to **Article 80** of the **Constitution of India**, the President has the power to nominate **12 members** to the Rajya Sabha who have special knowledge or practical experience in fields such as **Literature, Science, Art, and Social Service**.

• PT Usha famously missed an Olympic bronze medal in the **1984 Los Angeles Olympics** by just **1/100th of a second** in the 400m hurdles.

• She was also appointed to the **panel of Vice-Chairpersons** in the Rajya Sabha in December 2022, becoming the first nominated member to hold this position.
